scientific_integrity: All-orders proof is an induction on leaf elimination; finite exhaustive tests are only corroboration. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The support characterization and exact VC dimension hold for finite forests; C5 contradicts the extension to all graphs. No Littlestone claim. Literature coverage is not an exhaustive priority certification.
title: Shattered maximal-independent-set traces on forests are precisely induced-matching sides
